page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.14xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on a KVM hypervisor. Powered by the x86_64 processor architecture, this instance features 56 dedicated virtual CPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation ratio of 8.57 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include dedicated graphics processing units.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps, and the configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not have local storage bundled, meaning all persistent data volumes, operating system installations, and swap spaces depend on remote block storage solutions.

By providing a substantial memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.se1ne.14xlarge offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy operations where buying additional compute cores simply to secure extra RAM would be inefficient. A operational tradeoff is the total reliance on network storage for I/O operations. This profile fits memory-resident databases, distributed caching layers, and large-scale data analytics.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.14xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server powered by the x86_64 architecture on a KVM hypervisor. The instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 480.0 GB of RAM, providing roughly 8.57 GB of memory per core. It includes no bundled local storage, necessitating external network storage for file systems and databases, and lacks discrete GPU hardware. Network traffic is supported by a baseline bandwidth capacity of 10 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. The high memory density relative to core count delivers cost-effective infrastructure consolidation for systems requiring expansive working memory sets without the premium of attached local NVMe drives. Consequently, the ecs.se1ne.14xlarge is appropriate for in-memory databases, memory-heavy distributed computing, enterprise caching layers, and high-concurrency memory-intensive enterprise applications.
